pages.text: $(item)Diamond$(): Frost, Healing$(br)$(item)Redstone$(): Fire, Lightning$(br)$(item)Lapis$(): Frost, Leaping$(br)$(item)Emerald$(): Healing, Leaping$(br)$(item)Quartz$(): Fire, Frost$(br)$(item)Amethyst$(): Lightning, Frost$(br)$(item)Prismarine$(): Earth, Spikes$(br)$(item)Glowstone$(): Haste, Healing$(br)$(item)Echo Shard$(): Lifesteal$(br)$(item)Ender Pearl$(): Blink, Wind

pages.title: Ring triggers
pages.text: Ring Trigger scrolls are the exception: they engrave the $(l:socket-sorcery:socketing/ring)ring itself$(/l), not a gem. The engraved ring chooses $(italic)when$() to cast; its socketed gem chooses $(italic)what$() to cast.
